title: Reverse erasure step
statement: Let $x,w$ be Boolean words, let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\le |x|$, and let $b$ be a bit. From state $1$ with $w$ followed by $b$ stored on the work tape, the work-tape head at position $|w\mathbin{++}[b]|-1$, and empty output, one step erases the final bit and moves the head to position $|w|-1$. The new state is $2$ if $b$ is true and $1$ if $b$ is false; the input-head position remains $i+1$, and the output remains empty.
replaced:
One step of the stripping machine in its reverse state with buffer $w b$ and
work head on the final cell erases that cell and moves left, entering the
rewind state when the erased bit $b$ is $1$ and staying in the reverse state
when $b$ is $0$.
